A backup is one file with everything: food log, foods, recipes, saved meals, weight, water, activity, photo estimates, goals and settings. API keys are never in it. Keep one somewhere other than this phone.
On Today, after 14 days without a backup
No meal photos in this file.
Photos make the file much bigger. Your log keeps every entry either way.
Next, choose where to save it: this phone, an SD card, or a cloud app like Google Drive or OneDrive.
If you forget this password, the backup can\'t be restored. Nobody can recover it.
Type the password it was saved with.
Wrong password, or the file was changed.
Pick a folder once and Forkcast saves a backup there every week. It can be on this phone, an SD card, or a cloud app\'s folder (Google Drive, OneDrive and others). Forkcast only sees that folder.
Saving to the folder you chose
Saved on this phone so backups can run on their own

Automatic backups will be locked with this password. It\'s saved on this phone (encrypted) so backups can run without you. To restore on another phone you\'ll need to type it, and if you forget it, those backups can\'t be restored.
Stop automatic backups to this folder?
Backups stop and Forkcast lets go of the folder. Backups already there stay.
Forkcast can\'t reach the backup folder any more. It may have been moved or deleted. Choose a folder again.
Backups are set to use a password, but none is saved on this phone. Turn the password off and on again to set it.
The backup couldn\'t be saved. Check that there\'s free space, or choose another folder.
Deleting backups needs your phone\'s screen lock (PIN, pattern, password, fingerprint or face), so nobody holding your phone can remove them.
